info.name: Fetch Audio Metadata For A Word

params.name: word
params.description: Word to get audio for.

params.name: useCanonical
params.description: Return the canonical form of the word (e.g. 'cats' -> 'cat').

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs:
The metadata includes a time-expiring fileUrl which allows reading the audio file
directly from the API. Currently only audio pronunciations from the American Heritage
Dictionary in mp3 format are supported.

params.name: word
params.description: Word to return definitions for.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: partOfSpeech
params.description: CSV list of part-of-speech types.

params.name: includeRelated
params.description: Return related words with definitions.

params.name: sourceDictionaries
params.description: Source dictionary to return definitions from. If 'all' is received, results are returned from all sources. If multiple values are received (e.g. 'century,wiktionary'), results are returned from the first specified dictionary that has definitions. If left blank, results are returned from the first dictionary that has definitions. By default, dictionaries are searched in this order:- ahd-5, wiktionary, webster, century, wordnet.

params.name: useCanonical
params.description: Return the canonical form of the word.

params.name: includeTags
params.description: Return a closed set of XML tags in response.

items.docs: Returns definitions for the given word from one or more source dictionaries.
